events.title: Flaminius's land law
events.text: The tribune Gaius Flaminius has the ager Gallicus, taken from the Senones, divided among Roman settlers; the Boii fear they are next.

events.title: The great invasion
events.text: Boii, Insubres and Gaesatae mercenaries from beyond the Alps march into Etruria with some seventy thousand men.

events.title: Defeat at Faesulae
events.text: The Gauls lure a Roman army into a trap near Faesulae and kill some six thousand.

events.title: Battle of Telamon
events.text: Caught between two consular armies, the Gauls are destroyed: forty thousand dead and ten thousand captured.

events.title: The Boii submit
events.text: Roman armies enter the Boii's lands and force them to submit.

events.title: Flaminius crosses the Po
events.text: Now consul, Flaminius invades Insubrian territory and defeats them, then triumphs against the Senate's wishes.

events.title: Clastidium
events.text: The consul Marcellus kills the Gallic king Viridomarus in single combat and wins the spolia opima.

events.title: Mediolanum falls
events.text: The Romans take the Insubres' chief town and the Insubres surrender.

events.title: Via Flaminia
events.text: Flaminius, as censor, builds a great road from Rome over the Apennines to Ariminum.

events.title: Two new colonies
events.text: Rome plants six thousand colonists each at Placentia and Cremona, on land taken from the Gauls.

events.title: Siege of Mutina
events.text: The Boii and Insubres rise, drive out the colonists and besiege them in Mutina.

events.title: Over the Alps
events.text: Hannibal comes down into Italy with twenty thousand foot and six thousand horse left of his army.

events.title: The Taurini
events.text: Hannibal storms the chief town of the Taurini, who had refused his alliance.

events.title: The Ticinus
events.text: Hannibal's cavalry routs the Romans; the consul Publius Scipio is wounded.

events.title: Gauls desert Rome
events.text: Two thousand Gallic soldiers in the Roman camp kill their neighbours and go over to Hannibal.

events.title: Battle of the Trebia
events.text: In the snow, Hannibal ambushes and crushes the Roman army; Gauls flock to his camp.

events.title: Through the marshes
events.text: Hannibal crosses the flooded Arno marshes and loses the sight of one eye.

events.title: Lake Trasimene
events.text: Flaminius, author of the land law, dies with fifteen thousand men in an ambush by the lake.

events.title: Battle of Cannae
events.text: Gauls and Spaniards hold Hannibal's centre as Africans and cavalry encircle the Roman army.

events.title: Litana forest
events.text: The Boii ambush and destroy a Roman army; its commander's skull becomes a gilded cup.

events.title: Capua defects
events.text: Capua, Italy's second city, opens its gates to Hannibal.

events.title: Sardinia revolts
events.text: Hampsicora's revolt and a Carthaginian landing are crushed near Cornus.

events.title: Syracuse breaks away
events.text: After Hiero II's death, Syracuse turns against Rome and is besieged by Marcellus.

events.title: Tarentum taken
events.text: Hannibal seizes the great Greek port of Tarentum by night.

events.title: Syracuse falls
events.text: Marcellus takes Syracuse; the mathematician Archimedes is killed in the sack.

events.title: Hannibal at the gates
events.text: To save Capua, Hannibal marches to the walls of Rome, but cannot take it.

events.title: Capua falls
events.text: Rome retakes Capua and punishes its leaders harshly.

events.title: Tarentum retaken
events.text: Fabius Maximus recaptures Tarentum through treachery.

events.title: Hasdrubal's march
events.text: Hannibal's brother crosses the Alps, recruits Gauls and besieges Placentia.

events.title: The Metaurus
events.text: Hasdrubal is defeated and killed before he can join Hannibal.

events.title: Mago at Genua
events.text: Hannibal's brother Mago lands in Liguria to raise a new Gallic war.

events.title: Mago defeated
events.text: Mago is beaten in Insubrian territory and dies of his wounds at sea.

events.title: Hannibal leaves Italy
events.text: After fifteen years, Hannibal sails from Croton to defend Carthage.

events.title: Battle of Zama
events.text: Scipio defeats Hannibal in Africa; Carthage sues for peace.

events.title: Placentia sacked
events.text: Led by the Carthaginian Hamilcar, Gauls and Ligurians sack Placentia.

events.title: Battle of Cremona
events.text: The praetor Furius Purpureo destroys Hamilcar's army before Cremona.

events.title: Battle of the Mincius
events.text: The Cenomani change sides mid-battle and the Insubres are crushed.

events.title: Comum falls
events.text: Marcellus takes Comum; the Insubres accept a treaty with Rome.

events.title: Battle of Mutina
events.text: The consul Merula defeats the Boii in a costly battle.

events.title: The Boii crushed
events.text: Scipio Nasica defeats the Boii, who give up half their land to Rome.
